title: Physics-Constrained Adaptive Flow Matching for Climate Downscaling
code_availability: The preprocessed training dataset, code for training and evaluating PC-AFM (including the ESMValTool diagnostic recipes used in this study), and trained model weights for all evaluated variants will be archived and made publicly available once the paper is accepted.
testbed_rationale: The focus of this work is generative super-resolution/downscaling of climate fields rather than subgrid-scale atmospheric parameterization or surrogate emulation.
pain_points: Generative downscaling models violate physical conservation laws (mass, moisture) when coarsened.
Severe geographic generalization drops and systematic wet biases when models trained on one region are transferred out-of-distribution.
Gradient conflicts between physical conservation loss terms and generative/reconstruction objectives leading to suboptimal performance.
Spectral degradation and suppression of intermediate-scale spatial variance in moisture fields in out-of-distribution regions.
Assumption that large-scale averages exactly match fine-scale spatial averages does not hold when driving inputs come from biased GCMs in real-world operational downscaling.
